title: Jus Family Cafe
description:
Rooted in the Pico Neighborhood 
Robbie Jones, owner of Jus' Family Cafe Coffee Bar, has spent more than six decades in Santa Monica’s 90404 community. Today, her café serves as both a gathering space and a place that honors local history, with walls that celebrate generations of families and community voices.

Jus' Family Cafe Coffee Bar
📍 1819 Pico Blvd Unit A
